title: pack adds a check: note to a good verdict whose top hits are scattered and weak, calibrated on the eval set against the off-kb list

notes: Premise: an offline probe on 2026-10-11 found no single feature (NQC-style spread of the top ten BM25 scores, rarest key word's IDF, top score, key-word count, domains of the top three articles) that flags any of the 15 off-kb goods without flagging an eval good; the pair (top three articles in two or more domains, top score under 18) flagged 12 of 15 off-kb goods and 10 of 205 eval goods, so it is a note, not a verdict change. QPP research: predictors vary most with the collection and do not generalize, and QPP-driven selective processing gives marginal gains (public/agents/hybrid-retrieval.md, Query performance prediction, S-lsfxdurw); hence calibration on this kb's labelled sets. Depends on ST-efyc4jiw so the off-kb labels are right first. Planned 2026-10-12: premise is the probe in these notes (no single feature separates; the pair flagged 12 of 15 off-kb goods and 10 of 205 eval goods); the pack_scatter_check test runs the verdict benchmark's calibration and asserts its printed counts and that it reads no lookup_heldout.csv row. rag.py eval passes before the work (621 of 621) and pins the unchanged verdicts.
